title: Veve — CLI self-declaration manifest
description: Every graduated CLI ships a veve.json beside its bin. The veve is the symbol that summons the tool: it declares the contract (interface), the determinism class (LG-5 — load-bearing), the vectors that pin behavior, and the policy fields finn's sandbox allowlist is derived from. asson-doctor refuses graduation (L3+) without a valid veve. Production home for this schema: loa-hounfour as TypeBox with a constraint file (e.g. determinism=re_executable => network=false; vectors.length >= 1 for L3) and test vectors.

allOf.$comment: Fork discipline (the EIP lesson): validators support the window {0.1.0, 0.2.0}. 0.2.0 makes liveness REQUIRED — safety says nothing bad happens, liveness says something good eventually does, and a CLI without a clock is a loiter incentive. 0.1.0 veves remain valid (old-rules artifacts are old-rules artifacts; no fabricating chains against formats that lack them) but earn a doctor warning until upgraded.

veve_version.description: Validators dispatch on this and support a {N, N+1} window with a published deprecation policy. Bump in named fork-trains, never silently.

name.description: Verb-first slug (house slug pattern: no trailing/double hyphens).

version.description: Semver. Immutable once attested: bump, never republish.

entry.description: Path to executable, relative to the veve

subcommands.description: Feeds finn CommandPolicy.subcommands. Empty array = single-verb CLI.

class.description: re_executable: same input closure → same bytes, forever, fraud-provable by replay. attestable: touches network/clock/randomness — recorded as testimony, never replayed. Misclassification is the substrate's main integrity lie.

declared_by.description: effect_type = derived from an Effect signature with requirements `never` (machine-checked, strongest). author = honor system (weakest — doctor warns). trace_audit = inferred from N clean sandbox runs with network denied.

ambient.description: Required iff class=attestable: name the entropy sources. An attestable CLI with empty ambient is a contradiction the doctor flags.

rel_required.description: Rules Enforcement Level the tool DEMANDS of its invoking context (declared by the tool, enforced by the room). competitive = recorder on, gates armed, controlled vocabulary in force — required for tools that emit outbound comms, move funds, or touch the legal register. Undeclared = casual. A competitive-REL tool invoked in a casual room is a doctor finding and (once finn honors x_rel_required) a sandbox refusal.

timeout_s.description: Hard wall for one invocation — the enrage timer. Having a clock is soundness (model-free, never optional at 0.2.0); the MAGNITUDE is ergonomics (tune per tool and model tier).

expected_p95_s.description: Pace split for gecko: invocations past p95 are visibly off-pace before any wall hits. Absent = pace-blind (doctor warns).

mode.description: L3 CLIs are skeleton: they MUST terminate (oneshot — a process with an EOF). daemon = long-running infrastructure, governed elsewhere; a daemon claiming L3 is a category error the doctor fails.

liveness.description: Forward-progress declaration (0.2.0+). Complements safety: a tool that can hang is a span that can loiter.

output_schema.description: Optional path/URL to a JSON Schema for stdout_json output — the typed half of the ABI.

exit_codes.description: Map of code→meaning beyond 0/1. Exit codes are the smallest gate; document them.

expect_output_hash.description: sha256 of canonical stdout (JCS for JSON output, raw bytes for text). Harvested from the live runs that triggered graduation — the runs that proved the need become the tests that pin the behavior.

vectors.description: Golden vectors. L3 graduation requires ≥1 for re_executable CLIs. Attestable CLIs may pin vectors under injected test layers (TestClock, seeded Random) — note it in the name.

level.description: L1 committed script · L2 promotion proposed · L3 CLI (veve+vectors+attestation) · L4 legal (finn allowlist + construct manifest) · L5 network (freeside registry/beacon). asson-doctor computes the EARNED level from evidence; this field is the CLAIMED level; divergence is a finding.

evidence_runs.description: Run IDs whose recorded invocations justified promotion (done-twice-becomes-a-path, sensed not requested).

tree_hash.description: Hash of the CLI's file tree (sorted path:contenthash lines) — the codehash.

signed_by_key_id.description: sha256(signer_id ':' key_version) — the same Legba gatekeeper key ceremony. One ceremony, two attestation kinds: build (this) and run (gate tokens).

signature_type.description: Trust tier of the signature (hounfour keyring enum). dev_signature = a local developer key (cycle 1) → doctor reports attested-dev (warn). attestation = the CI key ceremony (cycle 3) → passes clean.

signature.description: base64 ed25519 over JCS of the veve WITHOUT this attestation block.

attestation.description: Build attestation. Replaces npm --provenance with the house key ceremony: this exact tree, from this exact commit, blessed by this key. Absent = unattested = cannot pass L3.
